lines: // The expectation's identity is the reference to its desired value.
.decl desired(run: symbol, token: symbol, value: symbol, reason: symbol)
desired(run, token, value, token) :- active(run), expectation(token, value).
// Use the same latest event time as known, retaining every agreeing evidence reference.
.decl current(run: symbol, token: symbol, state: symbol, value: symbol, reason: symbol)
known_latest(run, token, time), observed(run, token, time, _, "known", value, reason),
.decl non_absence(run: symbol, token: symbol, event_time: number)
known_latest(run, token, time), observed(run, token, time, _, state, _, _), state != "absent".
known_latest(run, token, time), observed(run, token, time, event, "absent", value, reason),
complete_sweep_interval(run, scope, sweep, start, stop), start <= time, time < stop,
